ChatSession.title: Chat Session
ChatSession.description: Represents a multi-turn conversation with the Gemini AI.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this session.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

lastMessageAt.description: Timestamp of the last message in the session.

title.description: A short summary title of the conversation.

ChatMessage.title: Chat Message
ChatMessage.description: A single message within a chat session.

sessionId.description: The ID of the parent chat session.

role.description: The role of the message sender.

content.description: The text content of the message.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the message was sent.

/chatSessions/{sessionId}.description: Root collection for user chat sessions.

/chatSessions/{sessionId}/messages/{mess.description: Sub-collection for messages within a session.
